messages:
alice.chen: quick thread — we need to decide scope for auth + tenant controls on the new API surface (chat/completions, embeddings, rerank, tool-calls, structured output). customers keep asking for project-level keys + rotation w/ zero-downtime. want to align on roadmap priorities and launch criteria.

ajay: +1. main engineering concern is how rotation affects long-lived streaming sessions and KV cache pinning.

sophie: from security: must support key rotation without exposing plaintext keys, audit logs for rotation events, and KMS-backed secrets. also we should require per-key minimum scopes (no all-access by default).

emma (sales): several enterprise pilots expect: (1) per-project scoping, (2) rotation webhooks or pull notifications, (3) ability to bind a key to Dedicated capacity. they treat rotation as compliance checklist item.

marcos: devex notes — SDKs need refresh token flow or short-lived session tokens to avoid forcing customers to re-deploy clients on rotation. console UX for key lifecycle (create, rotate, revoke, attach project) needs to land at beta.

kevin: infra/ops tradeoff — enforcing per-project isolation will require metadata on every request (e.g., X-Project or tenant header) or mapping key->project in auth service. mapping table is simplest but we must ensure auth lookup latency stays <1ms. caching auth results is doable but needs invalidation on rotation.

alice.chen: propose prioritization: must-have for launch: per-project keys, rotation API, audit events, SDK refresh token pattern, docs + migration guide, console key UI, tests for streaming w/ rotation. nice-to-have: per-route granular scopes (generate:write, embeddings:read), binding to Dedicated pools (post-beta).

ajay: implementation sketch: store key metadata {key_id, project_id, scopes[], created_by, created_at, rotated_from}. rotation endpoint: POST /v1/keys/:id/rotate -> issues new key, marks old key revoked but still accepts it for X minutes depending on policy. need a configurable grace window.

sophie: don't allow indefinite grace. default grace=5m for hosted, but customers can request up to 24h for dedicated/private via contract. rotation events must emit: key.created, key.rotated, key.revoked with actor and ip.

emma: for customer pilots we should offer rotation assistance (scripts, SDK examples) and a checklist: rotate client keys -> swap to session token -> revoke old key. this is a major ask for regulated customers.

marcos: SDK pattern example (pseudo):
```
// get short-lived token using API key
POST /v1/session_tokens { key: "sk_live_xxx" } -> { token: "st_abc", expires_in: 300 }
// use token for streaming and renew before expiry
Authorization: Bearer st_abc
```

marcos: that avoids breaking streaming on rotation if clients refresh proactively. need example code in JS/Python.

kevin: two infra constraints: (1) cache auth lookup for session tokens and short-lived tokens in memory on inference nodes; (2) ensure old key acceptance window respects cache TTL & propagate revocation via invalidation pub/sub.

alice.chen: launch criteria check (beta -> GA):
- beta: API + SDK support for key rotation, basic console UX, migration guide, audit logs, tests for streaming w/ 5m grace, telemetry on broken sessions
- GA: hardened infra invalidation (sub-second), KMS-backed stored keys, per-route scopes, binding to Dedicated, enterprise rollout docs, runbook for support

sophie: also require threat model review + pen test on token exchange endpoint before GA.

ajay: timeline suggestion: 6 weeks beta (engine + sdk + console minimal), 8–12 weeks to GA depending on infra work for revocation propagation.

emma: can we promise a migration window to pilot customers? they need 3mo runway.

alice.chen: we should offer pilot as extended grace by contract; default public rollout keeps short grace.

marcos: action items:
- ajay: draft API spec for keys + rotation + session tokens (due EOW)
- kevin: design cache invalidation + revocation pub/sub (due +2w)
- sophie: list audit fields + KMS requirements (due EOW)
- marcos: SDK refresh token examples + migration guide stub (due +1w)
- alice.chen: coordinate pilot customers and write launch criteria doc (due +3d)

deploy-bot: scheduled meeting created: #product-auth 1772505200 (calendar invite sent)

ajay: quick open question: do we allow multi-project keys (one key with multiple project_ids) or require one key per project? multi-project is simpler for customers but complicates RBAC and audit.

sophie: recommend single-project keys for GA. allow multi-project as enterprise opt-in with explicit admin consent and stricter audit.

emma: sales concurs — single-project default is easier for procurement/security reviews.

alice.chen: decision noted: single-project-by-default. multi-project later as opt-in.

marcos: also note: need to update rate-limiting to be keyed by project_id not raw API key to allow rotation without changing quotas.

ajay: acknowledged. will include quota mapping in spec.

alice.chen: thanks team — will follow up with spec link once ajay posts. please add any missing ask here. :thumbsup:
